worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.summary: Slam psychic force into the target's ground, leaving a psychic terrain that slows grounded foes; cast it while standing on one and it absorbs the field, detonating around you to hit every nearby foe for more.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.descrip: Spreads a psychic terrain of radius %1$s blocks at the impact point for %2$s s; while it lasts, grounded enemies inside have their movement slowed, while allies and airborne targets are unaffected.

If the user is grounded on a psychic terrain, it absorbs the field instead and detonates around itself within %1$s blocks, hitting every foe in range at 1.5x power, then spreads a fresh terrain at the impact point.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.timing: Range %1$s blocks; windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.expandingforce.prefere: Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to spread terrain; when off it stays put.
With this many enemies gathered within 6 blocks of the target, the cast is raised to a high-priority opening; a higher threshold is harder to trigger.
